description: One entry per asset (Bitcoin, ETH, SOL, USDC, USDT and every other tracked stablecoin, tokenized Treasury and L1) with its best current yield across DeFi and CeFi under BitcoinYield's risk-weighted ranking, its A-D risk grade, and a link to the full comparison. by_grade gives the best proven rate at grade A, B and C (A = lower risk), the tradeoff a holder chooses between: a grade is null when nothing proven at it pays materially more (at least 0.05 points and 5%) than a safer grade. best_apy and each by_grade rate are in percent, as the asset page shows them (today's rate, or its 7-day average when that is lower), and rate_basis says whether the source quotes an APY or an APR. To answer 'what is the best yield on X', quote by_grade, the lowest-risk grade first: best_apy is the by_grade step the risk-weighted ranking puts first and can be a higher-risk one, or one closed to US residents. An asset with no proven offer has no pick: best_apy is null and no_pick_reason says why its top-ranked offer is not one. Set max_risk to limit every pick to offers graded at or below that letter. Rates are variable and not advice. No key required. With no asset or stablecoin filter this tool answers the headline assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC, USDT, DAI, USDe, USD1, USDG, PYUSD, RLUSD); set all to true for every asset with a live yield.

all.description: Set to true for every asset with a live yield (about 60 entries, a large answer) instead of the headline assets. Ignored when asset or stablecoin is set.

asset.description: Filter to one asset by its symbol, e.g. BTC, USDC or USDE. For a token an asset is held as, give the asset: BTC for WBTC, ETH for stETH, DAI for USDS or sUSDS, SOL for jitoSOL (the tokens themselves are also read as their asset).

max_risk.description: Only consider offers graded at or below this letter: A (lower risk), B (moderate), C (elevated), D (higher).

stablecoin.description: Set to true to return only stablecoin assets.

name: list_yields

degraded_sources.description: The sources missing from this snapshot, if any.

partial.description: True when a data source was missing from this snapshot.

stale.description: True when part of this snapshot is over 6 hours old (a scheduled refresh was missed).

updated_at.description: When the feed was last refreshed (ISO 8601). It refreshes every 3 hours.

best_apy.description: The pick's rate in percent (5.2 means 5.2%) as its page shows it: today's rate, or its 7-day average when that is lower. An APR when rate_basis says so; the name is kept for compatibility. The pick is the by_grade step the risk-weighted ranking puts first, which can be a higher-risk step than grade A. Null when the asset has no pick yet (no_pick_reason).

by_grade.description: The best proven rate at each risk grade (a month of steady history and $10M or more to exit into). A grade is null when no proven offer of it pays materially more (at least 0.05 points and 5%) than a safer grade, both on its rate and on its rate without temporary rewards; between offers of one grade that pay about the same, the one paying materially more without temporary rewards is the pick.

market.description: The vault, market or token the rate is paid in.

rate.description: The step's annual rate in percent as its page shows it: today's rate, or its 7-day average when that is lower.

rate_rewards.description: The part of rate paid as temporary incentive rewards, which last only while someone funds them; null when under a tenth of rate. Say it when you quote rate.

rate_today.description: The latest reading: today's rate, or for a vault, pool or staking token the middle of its 1-day, 7-day and 30-day realized returns. Above rate when that reading is higher than the 7-day average.

url.description: This grade's offers on the asset's page.

us_available.description: Whether a US retail user can open it.
